PSI-10.rationale: Two clean summary tables (207 normal-flame rows and 120 inverse-flame rows) with fuel and diluent flows, initial/final oxygen mole fraction, pressure, stoichiometric mixture fraction, and adiabatic flame temperature. limitations: Only the summary tables are small enough for the MVP; the 2.18 TB raw archive is not ingested.
Tad (K) is a computed adiabatic flame temperature, not a measured temperature.
XO2 (init) and XO2 (final) are mole fractions, not percentages by volume.
20 of 207 normal-flame rows have no final XO2, pfinal, or pmean value; these are missing measurements, not zeros.

60 of 207 normal-flame rows contain RAMP or RAMPED qualifiers in six numeric columns; 11 of 120 inverse-flame rows contain RAMP or LOW O2 qualifiers. These are experiment qualifiers, not blanks and not zeros; preserve them as text and exclude them from numeric aggregation unless a documented rule exists.
Column labels contain inconsistent spacing and unit notation; preserve the raw header alongside the canonical field.
PSI-10.access_notes: Detail endpoint and both experimental-table downloads verified on 2026-11-08.

PSI-100.rationale: 47-column telemetry at 1 Hz with radiometers, anemometers, igniter voltages and currents, PCM air temperature, pressures, smoke-detector obscuration and scatter, fan differential pressure, body rates, and accelerations. limitations: Telemetry is engineering sensor data, not a processed flame-spread rate. Image-derived spread rates require separate processing.

The raw telemetry CSV has 3,972 physical rows, of which 3,966 have a non-negative RelativeSeconds value; the remaining rows are sentinel or pre-trigger values. The 1 Hz XLSX RawData sheet has 73,462 physical rows but only 11,449 contain data; the rest are empty formatting rows. The cleaned Saffire_Data_Table CSV has 11,450 physical rows and 11,449 valid rows. These are different exports and must not be concatenated without timestamp reconciliation.
Units are embedded in headers and are inconsistent: pressure channels include psi and psi/K, temperatures include degC, and body rates/accelerations use rad/s and m/s^2.
Some sensor channels are raw voltages or uncalibrated values; do not present them as physical concentrations without calibration documentation.
85 current files and 97 removed files; 35.21 GB. Sample images are delivered as ZIP archives.
The experimental table is a 2-row sample summary, not telemetry.
